Detailed Description

Dynamic array based on fixed-size blocks.

This array is able to grow dynamically without reallocating stored elements.

Growth allocates new blocks without moving existing ones. The directory of block pointers may be reallocated, but element addresses never change.

Allocated blocks are always of the same fixed size of 4 Ki pointers.

◆ tommy_arrayblk_clear()

void tommy_arrayblk_clear ( tommy_arrayblk *  array)

Removes all elements, preserving the allocated capacity.

Call tommy_arrayblk_shrink() after clearing to restore the initial capacity. Pointed-to elements are not freed. The array remains initialized and can be reused immediately.

Parameters
arrayThe array.

void tommy_arrayblk_swap ( tommy_arrayblk *  first,
tommy_arrayblk *  second 
)

Exchanges two initialized arrays without copying their elements.

Element references remain valid and belong to the other array. Passing the same array twice has no effect.

Parameters
firstThe first array.
secondThe second array.
Note
This operation is O(1).

◆ tommy_arrayblk_foreach()

TOMMY_API void tommy_arrayblk_foreach ( tommy_arrayblk *  array,
tommy_foreach_func *  func 
)

Calls the specified function for each element in the array.

You cannot add or remove elements, nor change the size of the array, from inside the callback.

If the callback frees the elements, the array retains dangling pointers. Call tommy_arrayblk_clear() before reusing it, or tommy_arrayblk_done() to release its storage.

Parameters
arrayThe array.
funcFunction to call with each element.
